description: A trailing newline matches the end anchor in the baseline but not here.
descriptor: { descriptor_version: "1.0", root: { type: "object", children: { a: { type: "string", pattern: "^a$" } } } }

divergence.note: docs/grammars.md §1.2 and §1.3 fix which layer reports each regex construct, and §1.2 states that the two implementations can name the same problem at different layers while the outcome (refused, named, never guessed at) does not differ. This is a documented, intentional divergence from the executed baseline under that rule (SPEC.md amendment 26), not a baseline defect.  docs/grammars.md §1.1 records the difference: the baseline end anchor also matches immediately before a single trailing newline, this engine does not, and an anchored pattern must not depend on that behavior. The baseline accepts the value; this product refuses it.
